Big Fist Quirk.name: Big Fist Quirk
Big Fist Quirk.description:
✊ You make your hands huge while your body stays its normal size.

🌱 At the start you grow a hand about a meter across for a short exchange, cover your upper body, and strike or catch within about two meters.
📈 With training: careful captures, climbing pulls, protected carries, broad air fans, punches that expand just before contact.
⚠️ Only your hands grow and stay flesh; blades and heat hurt, heavy swings tire you, and air fans move gas without cleaning it or supplying oxygen.
🔗 Canon Drawback, built in: Stamina Drain, as large hands and heavy swings exhaust your arms.
🎬 Canon Quirk: Itsuka Kendo's Big Fist. You are not related to her; people who know her Quirk notice the resemblance.

📈 Grants: Power +1, Quirk Control +10, Quirk Output +10, Grappling +5
⚡ Starting techniques: Broadhand Guard, Growing Palm Strike
Big Fist Quirk.traitNarrativeEffects:
Scale: enlarged hands, matching force and grip. Start: a meter-wide hand for a short exchange, guarding the upper body, striking or catching within about 2 m. Training: size, timing, repeats, gentle handling.
Limits: only hands grow (no arm stretch or armor) and stay flesh, hurt by edges, heat, focused force. Heavy or long use tires. Corridors cramp; a closing fist can crush. Fanning only moves air and gas: no purifying, oxygen, dousing every fire. Cupped hands: brief shelter, not sealed air.
Quirk Strain: light: guard, strike; moderate: careful capture, climbing pull, air fan; heavy: loaded carry, long grip; severe: signature expanding punches, long two-hand use.
Drawback: built in, the canon Stamina Drain.
Canon: Itsuka Kendo's Quirk; user is unrelated, no tie unless the story makes one; those who know it see the resemblance.
Type: Transformation.
Law: no excessive force; captures, break-ins, moving toxic gas need a license or self-defense.
Look: giant hands.
